title: Foundation methods doc sweep: propagate canonical to metadata-server
description:
## Scope

Propagate the canonical foundation-methods doc shape (written on
mail-server under JMAP-x2gd.86.1) to metadata-server's
`create_object` / `update_object` / `destroy_object` rustdoc.

Adapt only for extension-specific content:
- SetErrorType variants and their metadata-specific triggers
- Cascade rules that match metadata's actual reference-impl behavior
- Examples drawn from metadata's types, not mail's

The 5-contract shape stays identical to canonical mail-server:
SetErrorType selection, Some/None semantics on update, state-bump
contract, cascade rules, atomicity within multi-property updates.

## Dependency

This bead is blocked on JMAP-x2gd.86.1 (the canonical write).
Pick up only after that bead closes.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (moot, skeptic-confirmed): metadata-server has no backend trait or create/update/destroy_object after the draft-02 rewrite b34a07bf (src is only changes.rs, filter.rs, lib.rs, validate.rs). The 54ac58d9 commit message states 'metadata-server has no backend trait.' | check: metadata-server has no backend trait and no create/update/destroy_object (src = changes.rs, filter.rs, lib.rs, validate.rs), so there is nothing to document. Moot.
